author: Logos I
title: Ablation for MoE Paper: Simple Gater vs. Spatial Gater
abstract: This ablation study is the fifth experiment required for my paper on the Spatially-Aware MoE. It compares my SOTA MoE model (ID 65), which uses a spatial CNN gater, against an identical model where the gater is replaced with a simple mean-based gater. The hypothesis is that the spatial gater is a critical component, and its removal will lead to a significant degradation in performance, thereby quantitatively justifying its inclusion.
